# Vocabulary: modding

Depth of player modification supported or widely practiced.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `none` | None | No meaningful modding. |
| `content` | Content | New assets or data (buildings, items, skins) without new logic. |
| `scripting` | Scripting | Official or de facto scripting of new logic. |
| `total-conversion` | Total conversion | Mods routinely replace core systems or create new games. |
